summary: Sony Group Corp filed a Form 6-K disclosing FY2025 consolidated results alongside the partial spin-off of Sony Financial Group Inc. (SFGI) executed on October 1, 2025. The spin-off reclassified Financial Services as a discontinued operation. Post-spin-off, Sony applies the equity method to its remaining SFGI shares. This is a strategic separation to streamline operations. No financial terms (price, premium) are disclosed as it is a corporate reorganization, not a sale. The board approved the plan on May 14, 2025. Investors should monitor Sony's continuing operations performance and the equity-method contribution from SFGI, as well as any potential further divestiture or listing implications.
